hook: Your photo shows monasteries on stone pillars.
title: Monasteries Built On Giant Rock Pillars
description:
Meteora in Greece has monasteries built on top of tall sandstone pillars. Some are still reached by steps carved into the rock.

Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.
